name: Addon Repository: upgrade workflow actions and resolve dependency vulnerabilities
description:
## Why?

Two Addon Repository repositories are behind on dependencies, each for a different reason.

**Part 1 — **`addon-repository-actions-config` runs the reusable workflow called from every partner's addon repository. Two of its pinned actions still execute on the **deprecated **`node20` runtime (`actions/upload-artifact@v5`, `actions/github-script@v7`), and all four pinned actions are at least one major behind. When GitHub retires `node20`, partner builds start failing. Dependabot alerts are also **disabled** on this repo, so its zero vulnerability count is not evidence that it is clean.

**Part 2 — **`addon-repository-github-app` has **232 open Dependabot alerts** (8 critical, 92 high, 103 medium, 29 low), split across two lockfiles:

- **Root **`yarn.lock` — 89 alerts. Production code that processes partner webhooks and ZIP archives: unauthenticated DoS in `@octokit/webhooks`/`probot`, HMAC signature bypass in `jws`, RCE in `handlebars`, 4GB allocation from a crafted ZIP in `adm-zip`.
- `docs/yarn.lock` — 143 alerts. The public partner documentation site, pinned to Docusaurus 2.4.1 / React 17: critical advisories in `@babel/traverse`, `shell-quote` and `websocket-driver`, ten separate high-severity `axios` advisories (SSRF, credential leak, proxy header leak), plus `node-forge` signature forgery, `dompurify` mXSS and path traversal in `webpack-dev-middleware`.

The repo is roughly three years stale (`@types/node` 14, `jest` 26, `typescript` 4.9, `probot` 12, `express` 4), so piecemeal bumps will keep hitting the same walls.

## What?

**Part 1 — workflow actions (**`addon-repository-actions-config`)

Upgrade all pinned GitHub Actions to current majors so nothing runs on a deprecated Node runtime, and enable Dependabot on the repository. Current vs. latest:

Runtime

Affects `checks.workflow.yml`, `default.workflow.yml`, `deploy.workflow.yml`. Also bump `review_tool` dependencies (`eslint` ^8 → 9, `glob`).

**Part 2 — dependency vulnerabilities (**`addon-repository-github-app`)

Clear all critical/high alerts from **both** lockfiles and modernize the toolchain so the repo stays maintainable. Two sub-scopes, deliverable independently:

- **2a — application (root **`yarn.lock`): runtime and dev dependency upgrades, including the major bumps needed to clear alerts.
- **2b — documentation site (**`docs/yarn.lock`): Docusaurus 2.4.1 → 3.x, which also forces React 17 → 18/19, `@mdx-js/react` 1.x → 3.x and `prism-react-renderer` 1.x → 2.x. This is the larger of the two and the reason `docs/` cannot simply be lockfile-refreshed.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Part 1 — **`addon-repository-actions-config`

- [ ] All pinned actions upgraded to current majors; no action runs on `node20`
- [ ] All three workflows pass on a partner test repository — checks, default build, deploy
- [ ] Dependabot alerts enabled on the repository, and resulting critical/high findings in `review_tool` resolved
- [ ] `review_tool` upgraded (`eslint` → 9, `glob`) and `yarn review` produces identical results on `test-cases/good` and `test-cases/bad` as before the upgrade

**Part 2a — application (root **`yarn.lock`)

- [ ] Zero open critical/high Dependabot alerts in the root `yarn.lock`
- [ ] Runtime dependencies upgraded including the major bumps required to clear alerts (`probot`, `octokit`, `express`, `adm-zip`, `ssh2-sftp-client`), with breaking changes handled
- [ ] Dev toolchain upgraded: `@types/node` 14 → 22, `typescript` 4.9 → 5.x, `jest` 26 → current (incl. `ts-jest`), `eslint` 8 → 9, `@typescript-eslint` 5 → current, `prettier`, `nodemon`
- [ ] `yarn test`, `yarn lint` and `yarn build` pass on the upgraded versions
- [ ] Verified on a preview deployment: addon installation, webhook flow, artifact build and SFTP upload all work

**Part 2b — documentation site (**`docs/yarn.lock`)

- [ ] Zero open critical/high Dependabot alerts in `docs/yarn.lock`
- [ ] Docusaurus upgraded 2.4.1 → 3.x across `core`, `preset-classic`, `theme-mermaid` and `module-type-aliases`, with React and MDX upgraded to the versions it requires
- [ ] `docs/docusaurus.config.js` and `sidebars.js` migrated to the 3.x config format; `yarn build` and `yarn typecheck` pass with no MDX parse errors
- [ ] All existing pages render correctly, including Mermaid diagrams and the images under `docs/static/img/`
- [ ] Deployed docs site verified on a preview URL before production
